name: range-slider
title: Range Slider
description: A two-ended slider for a range: the nearer end follows the finger with a value bubble, over an optional histogram.

perf.budget: Thumbs and fill move on the UI thread. The readout and histogram re-render once per step while dragging; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The ends jump to new values set from outside, and the thumbs do not swell; dragging still follows the finger.
a11y.screenReader: Two adjustable elements ("Price, Minimum" and "Price, Maximum") with increment and decrement actions that never cross.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole 44 pt track takes the drag and the nearer end follows. Each thumb's slop makes it 44 pt.
